newsitem.title: USA: Asset Investors sees gain from restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Asset Investors sees gain from restructuring.

text.p: Asset Investors Corp said Monday it expects to record a gain in 1997 of about $7 million, or $0.28 per share, as a result of restructuring its asset base.

The company said it would contribute its portfolio of subordinate non-agency mortgage-backed securities into a structured transaction in which Asset Investors will retain a small equity interest in the portfolio.
After the structured transaction, the company will have at least $69 million of cash, after payment of transaction costs, payments to the manager, and repayment of related debt.

Asset Investors said it plans to reinvest its cash in real estate. It also expects to convert to an "umbrella partnership real estate investment trust" through the contribution of certain of its assets to an operating partnership.
Asset Investors is a real estate investment trust. It owns 27 percent of Commercial Assets Inc, another REIT.
